scope: TG2 successful-training sidecar verification and location-aware North-to-East materialization

observed_failure.checkpoint_status: six training jobs still running; no final checkpoint reused
issue: North materialization copied only the checkpoint run tree, while matrix integrity also requires initialization and per-rank data-order sidecars stored outside that tree.
Platform workers create those JSON sidecars through NamedTemporaryFile with root-only mode 0600, so the local scheduler cannot read East sidecars or transferred mode-preserving files.

change: Keep one dependency task per completed TG2 parent; East parents satisfy it in place, while North parents launch the materialization helper.
Validate initialization route identity and exactly four nonempty rank data-order records at the source before any transfer.

For North parents, hash-copy the checkpoint into the canonical East checkpoint root and the five sidecars into a user-writable scheduler staging root, quarantine differing pre-completion artifacts, and revalidate locally.
Run the joint integrity gate as a one-GPU East platform task so it can read root-owned canonical East sidecars; its resolver selects staged sidecars only for North runs.
Write the North materialization marker only after checkpoint state and all five sidecars pass local verification, using the exact marker name expected by the scheduler.
invariants: No training process, recipe, checkpoint, optimizer state, initialization payload, data order, model weight, task, scene, seed, intervention, or evaluation protocol is changed.
No sidecar from a failed pre-step or partial attempt is accepted merely because its filename matches; source identity, route, ranks, world size, and nonempty audit counts must pass.
A differing staged sidecar is preserved under a pre_materialization_quarantine suffix rather than deleted.
A partial staged sidecar directory is rejected instead of silently falling back to canonical data.
The nine-arm integrity gate and all nine evaluations remain blocked until all nine location-aware materializers complete.
